posts.community: SRM Contractors Limited - A niche Infra player
posts.text: Members who are tracking or invested in this company, wanted to know why is the stock price coming down. The promoters have subscribed to warrants at 517/sh, current price is significantly below that. Also they have good order book, Q1 ppt says 2.1k cr, but not sure if they have included Meccaferi order book in this figure because in Q4 call the mgmt said order book is 3k including Meccaferi. Nonetheless, their guidance continues to be very healthy. From that perspective, looks at a cheap valuation. Disc: small investment, thinking of increasing allocation
